coverage.summary: Nommi (Hi TOY / Sure Fun) blind-box catalog: 26 series (19 existing plus 7 added). 22 carry a release year; 19 have complete regular+secret rosters, 4 are partial and 3 are unknown. Rosters are mostly transcribed from TOYSEZ collection listings (Treasure Collector from the official Hi TOY store; Pinky Energy and The Entwined Fate from Calembou) and cross-checked against the official Hi TOY store (hitoyofficial.com) lineup text and Kikagoods/Calembou retailer lineup counts and secret names. Release years come from dated secondary series chronologies (Calembou series list dated 2026-01-24, TOYSEZ Nommi chronology), dated launch press releases, or, for some 2026 releases, first official/retailer listing dates.
gaps: No official brand-wide checklist or dated official launch calendar was found; most release years rest on secondary chronologies (Calembou blog, TOYSEZ chronology) that agree with first retailer listing dates, and Pinky Energy, Treasure Collector, Izakaya Bites and Sweetheart Plan years rest on first official/retailer listing dates in 2026.
Sitting Zoo is recorded as 2025 (TOYSEZ chronology; official Hi TOY store listing published 2025-11-28; Calembou listing 2025-12-10), but the Calembou series list states a January 2026 release.

Mibao Town and Fairytale Town are the same physical series (the official Hi TOY 'Fairytale Town' page names the product 'Nommi-Mibao Town Series'; both carry the Red Queen secret and an 8+1 lineup); both existing records now carry the same roster and should be merged.

Glutinous Rice 100% Sweetness is the series TOYSEZ sells as 'Sweetness 100%' (9 regular + Salty Sugus secret per Kikagoods, TOYSEZ and the official 9+1 count); no separate record was added for the TOYSEZ name.
Collecting Cutie Bags is partial: only the secret (Fortune Kitty) is named by a fetched source; the six regular names and the release year are unverified.
Pinky Energy is partial: the hidden figure is named 'Glace' by Calembou and 'Grace' by Kikagoods, so it is omitted; Hailey (1:96 special color edition) is recorded with isSecret true.
The Entwined Fate is partial: the hidden figure is unnamed and two of the eight confirmed-style names appear only as 'Sin?' and 'Saint?' on the retailer listing, so they are omitted.

Little World is partial: the official page lists a different-color hidden variant obtained by redemption card that no source names; its release year is null because the TOYSEZ chronology's 2023 conflicts with its own and Calembou's statement that Nommi debuted in 2024.
Baby (Mibao's Adoption House) has a null release year: the TOYSEZ chronology says 2025 while the Calembou series list dates a 'Baby Mibao Series' to December 2024.

Collecting Cutie Bags and Gummy Plan have null release years (no stated date; Gummy Plan was a pre-order with mid-October 2026 estimated departure when checked); Izakaya Bites, Sweetheart Plan and Gummy Plan rosters are unknown because no fetched source names their figures.

Official Hi TOY descriptions for About the Childhood, Sitting Zoo and Fairytale Town name 'Golden ...' secrets that contradict the matching TOYSEZ and Kikagoods secret names; those descriptions are not used for figure names.

Name variants: Magical Christmas Eve's deer is 'Gift-giving Deer' on TOYSEZ and 'Gift Delivering Deer' on Calembou (TOYSEZ form kept); Baby Sweetheart Bunny's secret is written 'Blue berry Cheese Pie' on TOYSEZ and 'Blueberry Cheese Pie' on Kikagoods.

Repository ingestion preserves numeric Shopify product identities, but member IDs remain null and new series use catalog: identities; retail case sizes, purchase options, restocks and collector V-numbers are not figures or manufacturing batches.
